title: [finding] contract-review :37's SELF-REVIEW predicate is unreachable under `mode:subagent` by construction (a branch never equals a session id) — the text should say the in-seat review of subagent-built PRs is the design, and the predicate guards `mode:remote` only
body:
Filed by the signed-off `domain:skills` seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, at 2026-09-16T06:57Z, from the objectui `domain:ui` seat's hand-off (session_01XeoGH6X7MtfbjcRDscyXi1, objectui#5560 comment 5692164248, item ①), verified by the seat on `origin/main` `cd8df644`.

## Reading

`references/contract-review.md` :35 「独立性对(机读):`Implemented-by:` 写产 diff 者身份;`mode:subagent` 记分支,`mode:remote` 记 session id。」, :36 「`Reviewed-by:` 写渲染或采纳裁决的席位 session …」, :37 「两者同 session ⇒ 报 SELF-REVIEW …」 and SKILL.md :476 「`mode:subagent` 下 dev 与 PM 同 ID,身份看分支」 together mean: under `mode:subagent` the two lines are a branch name and a session id, so the SELF-REVIEW predicate at :37 is UNREACHABLE by construction — the machine-read independence check is satisfied by a spelling convention, not by session independence. That is the DESIGN (the maintainer's 2026-09-16 ruling, in text since PR #18363: the dispatching seat reviews its own subagent-built PRs in-seat at the tier; independence is the served tier + the record, and SELF-REVIEW guards the `mode:remote` case where a dev session would sign its own work) — but :37 does not say so, and a seat reading it believes it is being checked. The harness auto-mode classifier's `[Self-Approval]` refusal on objectui PR #9578 is the external reader that disagreed with the text (recorded on platform-readings by PR #18363).

## What is asked

One in-place re-key (≤120 B; contract-review.md is 60 / 60, headroom 0): :37 — or :35 if it fits better — says the predicate is reachable only for `mode:remote` (a session signing its own diff) and that a subagent-built PR reviewed in-seat at the tier is the design, not a self-review the predicate would catch (e.g. 「两者同 session ⇒ 报 SELF-REVIEW(只 `mode:remote` 可达;子代理产物席内达档审是设计);…」 — the dev fits the 120 B). `references/contract-review.md` only; references tier (default judgment tier build, in-seat review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, in-seat landing). ⛔ Do not weaken the predicate itself or touch SKILL.md :476.

Grading (lane self-triage): p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`. No serial constraint (PR #18363 landed the tier re-key on :26 / :41 / :51 / :52 of the same file — a different region; the successor merges `origin/main` if the queue asks).
